transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Ever since they made me the acting workflow lead, I’ve been pretty stressed. I walk into the warehouse already tense, and I’ve been snapping over little SAP errors. I’m missing cycle-count deadlines I never used to miss, and by the time I get home I’m too drained to play basketball or work on my sketches.
How long ago did you take on this new role as acting workflow lead?
About four months now—since they merged the inventory teams and put me in the acting workflow lead role.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless most days?
I’m not really sure. I know I’ve been stressed and worn out, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt sad or hopeless most days.
Before taking on this new role four months ago, did you experience this kind of constant worry or anxiety?
No, not like this. It really started after the team merger and I took the lead role. Within the first month or two, I could tell I wasn’t handling work the way I normally do.

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F41.1 because symptoms developed within 1-2 months of an identifiable psychosocial stressor and have lasted under 6 months without prior generalized anxiety, consistent with an adjustment disorder.
